proof.text: Obtain the augmented tensor data q and actual-unit reflectors for j. Apply lem-sf-open-factor-open-realization to obtain the fixed Open data; repeat for jprime.

Apply the existing completed projection theorem to q, then lem-sf-open-factor-projection-realization. This supplies the two tensor-completeness assertions, tensorRestriction, its unit equation and gamma_restriction.

Apply the existing completed exchange theorem, then lem-sf-open-factor-exchange-realization to obtain horizontal Pull data, normalized ordinary exchange, completedSquare, square_unit, beta_restriction and unit-precomposition injectivity.

Assemble Assertion with these fields. Naturality of eta and unit_commutes prove gamma_unit and beta_unit after cancelling each comparison hom/inverse. Each gamma and beta is a composite of isomorphisms, hence invertible. For beta_unique apply unit-precomposition injectivity to its given equation and the proved beta_unit equation.

title: Completed open restriction, constructibility and normalization of the open maps
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum and coefficients $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, $R=\mathcal O_E$, uniformizer $t$, and $A_n=R/t^n$, $n\ge1$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let
$$\begin{array}{ccc}U'&\xrightarrow{a}&U\\ j'\downarrow&&\downarrow j\\ X'&\xrightarrow{h}&X\end{array}$$
be a Cartesian square of finite-type $k$-schemes with $j$ open [def-cbc-open-immersion-square]. On each small pro-etale site use $B_W=\lim_n(A_n)_W$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], the ordinary module derived category $D(B_W)$, and its full derived-complete constructible category $D^b_c(W,R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed]. Use exact termwise ringed-slice extension by zero and restriction, $j_!\dashv j^*$ and $j'_!\dashv j'^*$ [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact], completed pullback [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], and completed tensor [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. Then:

(1) Open restriction preserves derived completeness and canonically equals completed open pullback, with the comparison from ordinary restriction equal to the completion unit. Its unit $K\to j^*j_!K$ is the identity under the open-slice identification. The derived open extension is fully faithful on the complete subcategories.

(2) For every $K\in D^b_c(U,R)$, without a finite-Tor hypothesis, $j_!K\in D^b_c(X,R)$ and
$$(j_!K)\otimes^L_{B_X}(A_n)_X\cong j_!\bigl(K\otimes^L_{B_U}(A_n)_U\bigr).$$
These canonical comparisons commute with the strict quotient transitions. Extension by zero preserves the cohomological interval of every finite reduction.

(3) For $K\in D^b_c(U,R)$ and $P\in D^b_c(X,R)$, let $\gamma^B:j_!K\otimes^L_{B_X}P\to j_!(K\otimes^L_{B_U}j^*P)$ be the canonical ambient open tensor map of [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization]. Under the canonical completion maps $\chi$ of [lem-fix-constructible-tensor-completion], the completed open projection map $\gamma^c$ of [def-exchange-projection] satisfies
$$\gamma^c\chi_{j_!K,P}=j_!(\chi_{K,j^*P})\gamma^B.$$
The map $\gamma^c$ is an isomorphism and $j^*\gamma^c$ is the identity under the specified open tensor identifications. For $\beta^c:Lh^*_{\mathrm{comp}}j_!K\to j'_!La^*_{\mathrm{comp}}K$, use exactly the strict-reduction construction of [lem-cbc-completed-extension-zero-comparison]; the map $\beta^c$ is an isomorphism and its restriction $j'^*\beta^c$ is the identity under the canonical pullback-composition and open-unit identifications. These assertions concern the actual completed morphisms and their units, with the quotient transitions retained.
